findings.evidence: Lines 66-70; `Finset.card` is `s.val.card`, so the `change` rests on defeq between `Multiset.card univ.val` and `Fintype.card (Fin n)`.
findings.fix: Close the goal after `rw [hx, Multiset.card_map]` with named lemmas (`Finset.card_univ`/`Finset.card_fin`) or `simp`, instead of `change`.
findings.issue: `change Fintype.card (Fin n) = n` silently unfolds `Fintype.card` and `Finset.card` to `Multiset.card univ.val`, with no comment explaining why a rewrite is unavailable.

findings.evidence: Line 81 `rw [IsRootEnumeration, hx, ← Multiset.map_map, Multiset.map_univ_val_equiv]` proves the definition can be unfolded by name, so the `change` at 87-88 is avoidable; lines 87-89 duplicate the tail of line 81.
findings.fix: Unfold by name as `comp_perm` already does (`simp only [IsRootEnumeration, ← Multiset.map_map, Multiset.map_univ_val_equiv]`), and derive `comp_perm` from `comp_perm_iff.mpr` (or the reverse) so the rewrite chain exists once.
findings.issue: `comp_perm_iff` unfolds the definition with an undocumented `change`, and then repeats verbatim the rewrite chain of `comp_perm` (line 81) — the same reasoning written twice.

findings.evidence: mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Polynomial/Roots.lean:484 `theorem aroots_def ... : p.aroots S = (p.map (algebraMap T S)).roots := rfl`; :488 `mem_aroots'` is stated about `p.aroots S`, while `mem_roots_iff` (line 73) is about `(f.map (algebraMap F L)).roots`.
findings.fix: Insert the explicit lemma, e.g. `Polynomial.mem_rootSet'.trans <| Polynomial.mem_aroots'.symm.trans (Polynomial.aroots_def f L ▸ hx.mem_roots_iff)`, or prove it in tactic mode rewriting with `Polynomial.aroots_def`.
findings.issue: `Polynomial.mem_aroots'.symm.trans hx.mem_roots_iff` type-checks only because `Iff.trans` unfolds the wrapper `p.aroots L` to `(p.map (algebraMap F L)).roots`; the identification is undocumented defeq.

summary: Two undocumented `change` steps unfold `Fintype.card`/`Finset.card` and the `IsRootEnumeration` definition where a named rewrite already works elsewhere in the same file, and `mem_rootSet_iff` chains `Iff.trans` across the `aroots`/`roots` wrapper by definitional equality instead of `Polynomial.aroots_def`.
